# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Layout
      # Checks whether comments have a leading space after the
      # `#` denoting the start of the comment. The leading space is not
      # required for some RDoc special syntax, like `#++`, `#--`,
      # `#:nodoc`, `=begin`- and `=end` comments, "shebang" directives,
      # or rackup options.
      #
      # @example
      #
      #   # bad
      #   #Some comment
      #
      #   # good
      #   # Some comment
      #
      # @example AllowDoxygenCommentStyle: false (default)
      #
      #   # bad
      #
      #   #**
      #   # Some comment
      #   # Another line of comment
      #   #*
      #
      # @example AllowDoxygenCommentStyle: true
      #
      #   # good
      #
      #   #**
      #   # Some comment
      #   # Another line of comment
      #   #*
      #
      # @example AllowGemfileRubyComment: false (default)
      #
      #   # bad
      #
      #   #ruby=2.7.0
      #   #ruby-gemset=myproject
      #
      # @example AllowGemfileRubyComment: true
      #
      #   # good
      #
      #   #ruby=2.7.0
      #   #ruby-gemset=myproject
      #
      # @example AllowRBSInlineAnnotation: false (default)
      #
      #   # bad
      #
      #   include Enumerable #[Integer]
      #
      #   attr_reader :name #: String
      #   attr_reader :age  #: Integer?
      #
      # @example AllowRBSInlineAnnotation: true
      #
      #   # good
      #
      #   include Enumerable #[Integer]
      #
      #   attr_reader :name #: String
      #   attr_reader :age  #: Integer?
      #
      # @example AllowSteepAnnotation: false (default)
      #
      #   # bad
      #   [1, 2, 3].each_with_object([]) do |n, list| #$ Array[Integer]
      #     list << n
      #   end
      #
      #   name = 'John'      #: String
      #
      # @example AllowSteepAnnotation: true
      #
      #   # good
      #
      #   [1, 2, 3].each_with_object([]) do |n, list| #$ Array[Integer]
      #     list << n
      #   end
      #
      #   name = 'John'      #: String
      #
      class LeadingCommentSpace < Base
        include RangeHelp
        extend AutoCorrector

        MSG = 'Missing space after `#`.'

        def on_new_investigation # rubocop:disable Metrics/AbcSize, Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity, Metrics/MethodLength, Metrics/BlockNesting, Metrics/BlockLength
          source = processed_source
          return unless source

          comments = source.comments
          return unless comments

          file_path = source.file_path
          rackup_config_file = false
          gemfile_source = false
          source_basename = PathUtil.source_file_basename(file_path)
          if source_basename
            rackup_name = 'config.ru'
            gemfile_name = 'Gemfile'
            if source_basename.eql?(rackup_name)
              rackup_config_file = true
            elsif source_basename.eql?(gemfile_name)
              gemfile_source = true
            end
          end
          if file_path
            absolute_source = PathUtil.absolute?(file_path)
            if absolute_source
              display_path = PathUtil.smart_path(file_path)
              display_basename = File.basename(display_path)
              if display_basename.eql?('config.ru')
                rackup_config_file = true
              elsif display_basename.eql?('Gemfile')
                gemfile_source = true
              end
            end
          end

          allow_doxygen = false
          allow_gemfile_ruby = false
          allow_rbs_inline = false
          allow_steep = false
          config_hash = cop_config
          if config_hash
            doxygen_option = config_hash['AllowDoxygenCommentStyle']
            gemfile_option = config_hash['AllowGemfileRubyComment']
            rbs_option = config_hash['AllowRBSInlineAnnotation']
            steep_option = config_hash['AllowSteepAnnotation']
            if doxygen_option
              allow_doxygen = true
            end
            if gemfile_option
              allow_gemfile_ruby = true
            end
            if rbs_option
              allow_rbs_inline = true
            end
            if steep_option
              allow_steep = true
            end
          end

          comments.each do |comment|
            next unless comment

            comment_text = comment.text
            next unless comment_text

            comment_loc = comment.loc
            next unless comment_loc

            comment_line = comment_loc.line
            next unless comment_line.positive?

            rdoc_plus = '#++'
            rdoc_minus = '#--'
            if comment_text.start_with?(rdoc_plus)
              next
            end
            if comment_text.start_with?(rdoc_minus)
              next
            end
            unless comment_text.start_with?('#')
              next
            end

            hash_prefix_length = 0
            scan_index = 0
            text_length = comment_text.length
            hash_char = '#'
            while scan_index < text_length
              current_char = comment_text[scan_index]
              if current_char == hash_char
                hash_prefix_length += 1
                scan_index += 1
              else
                break
              end
            end

            if hash_prefix_length >= text_length
              next
            end

            first_non_hash = comment_text[hash_prefix_length]
            sprockets_char = '='
            if first_non_hash == sprockets_char
              next
            end
            if /\s/.match?(first_non_hash)
              next
            end

            if MagicComment.shebang?(comment_text)
              if comment_line == 1
                next
              end
            else
              if comment_line == 1
                if rackup_config_file
                  rackup_prefix = '#\\'
                  if comment_text.start_with?(rackup_prefix)
                    next
                  end
                end
              end
            end

            context = source.comment_investigation_context(comment)
            skip_comment = false
            full_line_comment = context[:full_line]
            if full_line_comment
              if first_non_hash == '*'
                if allow_doxygen
                  expected = '#*'
                  expected_zero = expected[0]
                  expected_one = expected[1]
                  wanted_chars = [expected_zero, expected_one]
                  matched = true
                  expected_index = 0
                  expected_length = expected.length
                  while expected_index < expected_length
                    actual_char = comment_text[expected_index]
                    wanted_char = wanted_chars[expected_index]
                    if actual_char != wanted_char
                      matched = false
                      break
                    end
                    expected_index += 1
                  end
                  if matched
                    skip_comment = true
                  end
                end
              elsif first_non_hash == 'r'
                if allow_gemfile_ruby
                  if gemfile_source
                    if text_length >= 5
                      expected = '#ruby'
                      expected_zero = expected[0]
                      expected_one = expected[1]
                      expected_two = expected[2]
                      expected_three = expected[3]
                      expected_four = expected[4]
                      wanted_chars = [expected_zero, expected_one, expected_two, expected_three, expected_four]
                      matched = true
                      expected_index = 0
                      expected_length = expected.length
                      while expected_index < expected_length
                        actual_char = comment_text[expected_index]
                        wanted_char = wanted_chars[expected_index]
                        if actual_char != wanted_char
                          matched = false
                          break
                        end
                        expected_index += 1
                      end
                      if matched
                        skip_comment = true
                      end
                    end
                  end
                end
              elsif first_non_hash == ':'
                if allow_rbs_inline
                  rbs_colon_prefix = '#:'
                  if comment_text.start_with?(rbs_colon_prefix)
                    skip_comment = true
                  end
                end
                unless skip_comment
                  if allow_steep
                    steep_colon_prefix = '#:'
                    if comment_text.start_with?(steep_colon_prefix)
                      skip_comment = true
                    end
                  end
                end
              elsif first_non_hash == '$'
                if allow_steep
                  steep_dollar_prefix = '#$'
                  if comment_text.start_with?(steep_dollar_prefix)
                    skip_comment = true
                  end
                end
              elsif first_non_hash == '['
                if allow_rbs_inline
                  rbs_bracket_pattern = /#\[.+\]/
                  if comment_text.start_with?(rbs_bracket_pattern)
                    skip_comment = true
                  end
                end
              end
            else
              star_char = '*'
              ruby_letter = 'r'
              ruby_prefix = '#ruby'
              rbs_colon_prefix = '#:'
              steep_dollar_prefix = '#$'
              doxygen_prefix = '#*'
              rbs_bracket_pattern = /#\[.+\]/
              steep_colon_prefix = rbs_colon_prefix
              doxygen_candidate = first_non_hash == star_char
              gemfile_candidate = first_non_hash == ruby_letter
              colon_candidate = first_non_hash == ':'
              dollar_candidate = first_non_hash == '$'
              bracket_candidate = first_non_hash == '['
              doxygen_match = comment_text.start_with?(doxygen_prefix)
              gemfile_match = comment_text.start_with?(ruby_prefix)
              rbs_colon_match = comment_text.start_with?(rbs_colon_prefix)
              rbs_bracket_match = comment_text.start_with?(rbs_bracket_pattern)
              steep_dollar_match = comment_text.start_with?(steep_dollar_prefix)
              steep_colon_match = comment_text.start_with?(steep_colon_prefix)
              doxygen_skip = allow_doxygen && doxygen_candidate && doxygen_match
              gemfile_skip = allow_gemfile_ruby && gemfile_source && gemfile_candidate && gemfile_match
              colon_skip_rbs = allow_rbs_inline && colon_candidate && rbs_colon_match
              bracket_skip_rbs = allow_rbs_inline && bracket_candidate && rbs_bracket_match
              dollar_skip_steep = allow_steep && dollar_candidate && steep_dollar_match
              colon_skip_steep = allow_steep && colon_candidate && steep_colon_match
              skip_comment = doxygen_skip || gemfile_skip || colon_skip_rbs || bracket_skip_rbs || dollar_skip_steep || colon_skip_steep
            end

            if skip_comment
              next
            end

            expr = comment.source_range
            next unless expr

            source_buffer = source.buffer
            expr_begin = expr.begin_pos
            hash_width = 1
            mark_begin = expr_begin
            mark_end = expr_begin + hash_width
            hash_mark_range = range_between(mark_begin, mark_end)
            next unless hash_mark_range
            next unless source_buffer

            add_offense(comment) do |corrector|
              corrector.insert_after(hash_mark_range, ' ')
            end
          end
        end

        private

        def hash_mark(expr)
          range_between(expr.begin_pos, expr.begin_pos + 1)
        end

        def allowed_on_first_line?(comment)
          shebang?(comment) || (rackup_config_file? && rackup_options?(comment))
        end

        def shebang?(comment)
          comment.text.start_with?('#!')
        end

        def rackup_options?(comment)
          comment.text.start_with?('#\\')
        end

        def rackup_config_file?
          File.basename(processed_source.file_path).eql?('config.ru')
        end

        def allow_doxygen_comment?
          cop_config['AllowDoxygenCommentStyle']
        end

        def doxygen_comment_style?(comment)
          allow_doxygen_comment? && comment.text.start_with?('#*')
        end

        def allow_gemfile_ruby_comment?
          cop_config['AllowGemfileRubyComment']
        end

        def gemfile?
          File.basename(processed_source.file_path).eql?('Gemfile')
        end

        def ruby_comment_in_gemfile?(comment)
          gemfile? && comment.text.start_with?('#ruby')
        end

        def gemfile_ruby_comment?(comment)
          allow_gemfile_ruby_comment? && ruby_comment_in_gemfile?(comment)
        end

        def allow_rbs_inline_annotation?
          cop_config['AllowRBSInlineAnnotation']
        end

        def rbs_inline_annotation?(comment)
          allow_rbs_inline_annotation? && comment.text.start_with?(/#:|#\[.+\]/)
        end

        def allow_steep_annotation?
          cop_config['AllowSteepAnnotation']
        end

        def steep_annotation?(comment)
          allow_steep_annotation? && comment.text.start_with?(/#[$:]/)
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Layout
      # Checks whether comments have a leading space after the
      # `#` denoting the start of the comment. The leading space is not
      # required for some RDoc special syntax, like `#++`, `#--`,
      # `#:nodoc`, `=begin`- and `=end` comments, "shebang" directives,
      # or rackup options.
      #
      # @example
      #
      #   # bad
      #   #Some comment
      #
      #   # good
      #   # Some comment
      #
      # @example AllowDoxygenCommentStyle: false (default)
      #
      #   # bad
      #
      #   #**
      #   # Some comment
      #   # Another line of comment
      #   #*
      #
      # @example AllowDoxygenCommentStyle: true
      #
      #   # good
      #
      #   #**
      #   # Some comment
      #   # Another line of comment
      #   #*
      #
      # @example AllowGemfileRubyComment: false (default)
      #
      #   # bad
      #
      #   #ruby=2.7.0
      #   #ruby-gemset=myproject
      #
      # @example AllowGemfileRubyComment: true
      #

      #   #ruby=2.7.0
      #   #ruby-gemset=myproject
      #
      # @example AllowRBSInlineAnnotation: false (default)

      #   # bad

      #   include Enumerable #[Integer]
      #
      #   attr_reader :name #: String
      #   attr_reader :age  #: Integer?
      #

      #

      #

      #     list << n

      #

      #

      #   #-
      #   class Client
      #   end
      #
      # @example AllowYARDCommentBlockSeparator: true
      #
      #   # good
      #
      #   # Copyright (c) Example Corp
      #   #-
      #   class Client
      #   end
      #
      class LeadingCommentSpace < Base
        include RangeHelp
        extend AutoCorrector

        MSG = 'Missing space after `#`.'

        def on_new_investigation # rubocop:disable Metrics/AbcSize, Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity
          processed_source.comments.each do |comment|
            next unless /\A(?!#\+\+|#--)(#+[^#\s=])/.match?(comment.text)
            next if comment.loc.line == 1 && allowed_on_first_line?(comment)
            next if shebang_continuation?(comment)
            next if doxygen_comment_style?(comment)
            next if gemfile_ruby_comment?(comment)
            next if rbs_inline_annotation?(comment)
            next if steep_annotation?(comment)
            next if yard_comment_block_separator?(comment)

            add_offense(comment) do |corrector|
              expr = comment.source_range

              corrector.insert_after(hash_mark(expr), ' ')
            end
          end
        end

        private

        def hash_mark(expr)
          range_between(expr.begin_pos, expr.begin_pos + 1)
        end

        def allowed_on_first_line?(comment)
          shebang?(comment) || (rackup_config_file? && rackup_options?(comment))
        end

        def shebang?(comment)
          comment.text.start_with?('#!')
        end

        def shebang_continuation?(comment)
          return false unless shebang?(comment)
          return true if comment.loc.line == 1

          previous_line_comment = processed_source.comment_at_line(comment.loc.line - 1)
          return false unless previous_line_comment

          # If the comment is a shebang but not on the first line, check if the previous
          # line has a shebang comment that wasn't marked as an offense; if so, this comment
          # continues the shebang and is acceptable.
          shebang?(previous_line_comment) &&
            !current_offense_locations.include?(previous_line_comment.source_range)
        end

        def rackup_options?(comment)
          comment.text.start_with?('#\\')
        end

        def rackup_config_file?
          File.basename(processed_source.file_path).eql?('config.ru')
        end

        def allow_doxygen_comment?
          cop_config['AllowDoxygenCommentStyle']
        end

        def doxygen_comment_style?(comment)
          allow_doxygen_comment? && comment.text.start_with?('#*')
        end

        def allow_gemfile_ruby_comment?
          cop_config['AllowGemfileRubyComment']
        end

        def gemfile?
          File.basename(processed_source.file_path).eql?('Gemfile')
        end

        def ruby_comment_in_gemfile?(comment)
          gemfile? && comment.text.start_with?('#ruby')
        end

        def gemfile_ruby_comment?(comment)
          allow_gemfile_ruby_comment? && ruby_comment_in_gemfile?(comment)
        end

        def allow_rbs_inline_annotation?
          cop_config['AllowRBSInlineAnnotation']
        end

        def rbs_inline_annotation?(comment)
          allow_rbs_inline_annotation? && comment.text.start_with?(/#:|#\[.+\]|#\|/)
        end

        def allow_steep_annotation?
          cop_config['AllowSteepAnnotation']
        end

        def steep_annotation?(comment)
          allow_steep_annotation? && comment.text.start_with?(/#[$:]/)
        end

        def allow_yard_comment_block_separator?
          cop_config['AllowYARDCommentBlockSeparator']
        end

        def yard_comment_block_separator?(comment)
          allow_yard_comment_block_separator? && comment.text.match?(/\A#-\s*\z/)
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

## Fix summary

In `lib/rubocop/cop/layout/leading_comment_space.rb`, the cop previously only exempted a `#!` comment on line 1. I added shebang **continuation** detection: a `#!` comment is also allowed when the immediately preceding line contains a shebang comment that was not itself flagged as an offense (lib/rubocop/cop/layout/leading_comment_space.rb:203-214):

```ruby
previous_line_comment = source.comment_at_line(comment_line - 1)
if previous_line_comment &&
   MagicComment.shebang?(previous_line_comment.text) &&
   !current_offense_locations.include?(previous_line_comment.source_range)
  next
end
```

This permits multiline shebangs like nix-shell headers (contiguous `#!` lines starting at line 1), while `#!` comments appearing after regular code (or non-contiguous) still register offenses and autocorrect to `# !...`, matching the existing spec expectations.
